findings.text: The specification treats copied definitions as use-site paths, but `CommonTableCopies.originalPath` maps in-statement CTE copies back to their written definitions and collapses only stored-definition paths. Fix: preserve exact definition paths for in-statement CTEs and reserve use-site provenance for stored definitions.

The required quoting information cannot be recovered from the specified inputs because translation discards it for qualified names, table names and aliases. Fix: obtain that information from source tokens in the translation layer or explicitly extend the syntax contract to retain it.

The acceptance text expects CAST cases with no affinity, but `resolveOperand` assigns CAST the affinity of its declared type. Fix: distinguish unary-plus cases that remove affinity from CAST cases that supply it.

The acceptance text identifies `just verdict` as the byte-identity check for 53 prediction files, but that command checks claims without comparing a baseline and the current configuration produces 55 files. Fix: require an explicit comparison of all 55 prediction files against the baseline in addition to `just verdict`.
